start.text: *Torx jogs in place, synthetic sweat evaporating off titanium knee joints.* "180 beats per minute! Subdermal lung filters running at 94% efficiency! Don't break my cadence, driver!"

choices.text: "What kind of cyberware are you running in those legs?"
"How do you run through this smog without choking?"
"Ever see anything interesting on your perimeter laps?"

start_night.text: *Torx's running suit neon stripes pulse with rapid strobe rhythm.* "Night laps are the best. Zero civilian traffic on the sidewalks, and the neon reflections look fast as hell!"

choices.text: "Aren't you worried about gang ambushes in the dark?"
"Seen any corporate activity on the boulevards?"

start_post_battle.text: *Torx stops to catch his breath.* "Holy nitro! I was on lap 14 near the north highway when Mack's rig collided with that Cawdor interceptor! Shrapnel flew 50 meters! The rush was incredible!"

jogger_cyberware.text: Hydraulic titanium tendons, carbon-fiber arches, and kinetic energy recovery dynamos. Every step I take charges my neural suit batteries! Porter at The Pit has some similar actuator mods if you want your car's suspension dialed in!

choices.text: "Good to know. Porter knows his hardware."

smog_lungs.text: Dual electro-static particulate scrubbers inside the trachea. Filters out 99.8% of industrial carbon soot and acid mist. Cost me 800 Credits, but now I breath cleaner than corporate executives!

track_intel.text: The long straightaway along Sector 2 is completely clear of speed cameras this evening. If you want to open up your engine throttle without tripping police alerts, that's the stretch to hit.

gang_speed.text: The Red Crows tried to corner me once. Good luck catching someone with 35km/h sustained sprint speed and kinetic burst boosters! They were eating my ozone wake!

mack_cheer.text: Tell Mack he's got fans in the running clubs! If he ever needs a high-speed courier on foot to dodge road blockades, I'm ready to lace up!
